name: Bahamas (colony, 1964–1973)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the badge of the Crown Colony of the Bahama Islands, a ship chasing pirates within a garter under a crown, in the fly.
history: Blue Ensign defaced with the emblem of the Crown Colony of the Bahama Islands, showing a ship driving off pirates with the motto 'Expulsis piratis restituta commercia'; the badge dates from about 1850 and was officially approved in 1964, when the colony gained internal self-government. The present flag was first hoisted at midnight on 10 July 1973, the day of independence.

features.role: colonial badge of the Bahama Islands
